card.name: Inside condition names in patient restrictions
card.fires_on: Words that finish or continue a disease or condition name, or a short qualifier, in sentences about which patients a drug is used in or monitored for. Examples are Malignancy, Parkinson's disease, epilepsy, and 'may develop'.
